title: Why our release checklist moved to an AI agent

scenes.title: Opening
scenes.heading: Release Day, Rewritten
scenes.on_screen: From a 40-step checklist to one review
scenes.voiceover: Release day used to take all afternoon.
scenes.visual: Cream paper background, the teal robot with an orange backpack waves beside a large title card that draws itself in.

scenes.title: Before vs after
scenes.heading: Same release, two afternoons

items.label: Before
items.text: Forty manual checks across five tools

items.label: After
items.text: The agent runs them; we review one report

scenes.voiceover: Forty manual checks across five tools. Now the agent runs them, and we review a single report.
scenes.visual: Split frame: left desk buried in sticky notes ticking clock; right side the robot hands over one clean report card.

scenes.title: How it works
scenes.heading: Three steps, no copy-paste
scenes.voiceover: It collects the tickets, verifies every build, and writes one page we can approve.
scenes.visual: Three cards slide in left to right, connected by drawn arrows with glowing dots travelling along the path.

scenes.title: Result
scenes.heading: Time to sign-off
scenes.voiceover: Sign-off now takes thirty-five minutes, down from four hours.
scenes.visual: A large counter ticks up to 35 min on cream background with a soft teal glow.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.on_screen: Try it on your next release
scenes.voiceover: Try it on your next release.
scenes.visual: Navy end card, white title, mint subline, light confetti.
